The materially new checked-FP64 division/square-root candidate is REJECTED at 11/22 in the sole pre-registered original ABBA. It passes 0/4 whole-call,11/16 inclusive-stage and0/2 provisioning-inclusive API conditions. Independent Decimal/rawXML agrees on all 22. Whole-call changes: forward legacy+4.611984%, forward modern−3.500589%, reverse legacy−4.193243%, reverse modern−1.760376%. API changes−4.887779% and−13.452918%. No retry/resampling/pooling/subtraction or acceptance change.

All numerical/ownership checks pass: 720288 injected good/bad estimates, the original 174268-record corpus on host and actual Float64-enabled stock Lavapipe, all 522804 expected words, complete three-stage program/interface/mode/barrier compiler checks, and original C8(51 markers54 joins32 complete readbacks). Ordinary called Endpoint code contains actual packed vdivpd/vsqrtpd and preserves integer fallbacks/fences, but this is not an inclusive benefit. The matched observer was reused byte-exactly, and only one C++ unit was compiled for the integrated pair.

Remaining7 controls and the cold frame were not run. No source shader adoption; PR62 still contains only the useful public Int64 admission correction. [Exact sources, binaries, raw trial and independent verdicts](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/a78c7e1b55c437396947b92118345af434ab2b1c/attestations/qualification/6b355fbf/checked-fp64-three-stage-rejected). All 11 owners are terminal/empty and 38 observed births absent. Canonical products remain unchanged and are reused from the previous pushed backup. This version is retired.

The separate public PR CI 39507921220 succeeds on all three platform integration jobs/30 named authority controls. Actual merge checkout 8ed795715ea15f5a67448b33f860d3b1042321e1 has the complete 0109ab46 tree. Five full qualification jobs were unrequested; all ultimate scientific/runtime/frame/provider/release requirements remain open. Next review concerns actual Lavapipe denormal execution support, with no provider code/property change or new trial yet.
